subject: Re: Scheduling │ APAC demo — clarify local date/time after ICS hiccup
body:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@kaitologistics.jp>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 07:42:00 +0900
Subject: APAC demo — proposed times (JST/SGT/AEST)

Hi Keiko —

Thanks for the interest this morning. We'd love to show a 30-minute walkthrough of Redwood Inference focusing on low-latency routing and Dedicated capacity options for logistics workloads.

I pulled three 30-minute windows that should fit typical business hours across your region:
- Tue Aug 17: 10:00–10:30 JST (Tokyo) / 09:00–09:30 SGT (Singapore) / 11:00–11:30 AEST (Sydney)
- Wed Aug 18: 16:00–16:30 JST / 15:00–15:30 SGT / 17:00–17:30 AEST
- Thu Aug 19: 08:00–08:30 JST / 07:00–07:30 SGT / 09:00–09:30 AEST

I've attached a calendar invite (redwood-demo-invite.ics) with the first option pre-filled. If any of those look off for you, say which timezone you prefer and I'll send a new invite with explicit timezone labels and separate invites for JST vs AEST recipients to avoid the local-day flip.

Also attaching a short mutual action plan so we can align scope before the demo (RW-MAP-4527-v1.pdf).

Best,
Nikhil
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks — I got the invite but my colleague Sam in Sydney is seeing the event at 11:00 PM his local time, which is clearly not during business hours. The invite shows "10:00 (local)" and when I open the .ics it says UTC+09:00, but Sam's calendar converted it to 11:00 PM AEST (next day). Could you check whether the invite was created in JST but without an explicit timezone tag for the event?

Keiko

keiko.tanaka@kaitologistics.jp

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@kaitologistics.jp>, Sam O'Neill <sam.oneill@bluewave.com.au>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:05:00 +0900
Subject: Re: APAC demo — timezone/ICS follow-up

Hi all —

Thanks for flagging, Keiko and Sam. Quick background: calendar files (.ics) can be ambiguous if the organizer's client inserts a floating time or the timezone identifier is something generic. Looks like my quick check shows the ICS was generated with a JST time but the TZID block was omitted, which can cause some clients to apply their local DST rules incorrectly (e.g., AEDT/UTC+11 vs AEST/UTC+10).

To resolve cleanly:
1) I'll generate two explicit invites — one tagged with TZID=Asia/Tokyo (for JP participants) and one tagged with TZID=Australia/Sydney (for AU participants). That makes the wall-clock time explicit across calendars.
2) For broader clarity, I'll include the UTC offsets in the event title (e.g., "10:00 JST (UTC+9) / 11:00 AEST (UTC+10 / AEDT UTC+11)").
3) I'll also add an alternate invite showing the same session in SGT (Singapore) so participants in Singapore see the correct local time.

Marcus: can you confirm we should demo the Dedicated routing section (20 mins) + Q&A (10 mins)?

Keiko & Sam — will send corrected invites in the next 20 minutes. Apologies for the confusion.

Regards,
Mina
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

--

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:12:00 +0900
Subject: Re: APAC demo — timezone/ICS follow-up

That's perfect, Mina. Yes — Dedicated routing + autoscale demo (20 mins), then 10 for Q&A and next steps. I'll prepare the workload example using a small logistics routing prompt so it's relatable to Kaito.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Updated invites — explicit TZs (please accept the one that matches your location)

Hi Keiko and Sam —

I've created three explicit calendar events so each participant's client will render the correct local time:
- "Redwood Demo — 10:00 JST (UTC+9) | 09:00 SGT (UTC+8)" — for Tokyo/Singapore attendees
- "Redwood Demo — 11:00 AEST (UTC+10) | 12:00 AEDT (UTC+11)" — for Sydney attendees (two variants created depending on DST)
- "Redwood Demo — 15:00 SGT fallback" — alternate time if the morning options don't work (we'll keep it short).

Attached: redwood-demo-invite.ics (this one is the corrected AEST-tagged invite). I also uploaded the mutual action plan to Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=RW-MAP-4527 — please review the scope before the session.

Keiko — you should see the Tokyo-tagged invite in your calendar as Tue 10:00 JST local time. Sam — please accept the Sydney-tagged invite I just sent; it should show your local time as Wed 11:00 AEDT (we created the AEDT variant because we've confirmed your office observes daylight saving).

If either of you prefer a single cross-region invite instead, tell me and we'll include clear UTC offsets in the subject line.

Thanks for the patience — looking forward to the demo.

Best,
Nikhil
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
